'''Michael Karas''' (born 1952) is a German physical chemistry scientist and Professor, known for his researches on [[matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization]] (MALDI), a technique in [[mass spectrometry]].<ref name="FU"/>

Michael Karas studied chemistry at the [[University of Bonn]], where he obtained a [[Doctor (title)|PhD]] in the field of [[physical chemistry]] in 1982. From 1983 to 1986, he was part of the [[Franz Hillenkamp|Hillenkamp]] research group in the Institut für Biophysik at [[Goethe University Frankfurt]]. In 1987, he followed Hillenkamp at Münster and both formed a group in the Faculty of Medicine at [[University of Münster]]. He returned to Frankfurt in 1995 as a full professor for Instrumental Analytical Chemistry.<ref name="FU">[https://web.archive.org/web/20090420060306/http://www.pharmazie.uni-frankfurt.de/PharmChem/Prof__Karas/index.html Short biography on  Frankfurt University web site]</ref>

== Awards ==
* 1997: Recipient of the [[American Society for Mass Spectrometry|John B. Fenn Award]] for a Distinguished Contribution in Mass Spectrometry
* 2003: Karl Heinz Beckurts Award, Germany's most important award for outstanding promotion of the partnership between science and industry<ref>{{cite web|title=Professoren Hillenkamp (Münster) und Karas (Frankfurt) erhalten Karl Heinz-Beckurts-Preis 2003 |url=https://www.uni-muenster.de/Rektorat/exec/upm.php?rubrik=Alle&neu=1&monat=200312&nummer=04827 |work=Bioanalytik revolutioniert |publisher=Presse- und Informationsstelle |accessdate=27 June 2012 |language=German |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120304005827/http://www.uni-muenster.de/Rektorat/exec/upm.php?rubrik=Alle&neu=1&monat=200312&nummer=04827 |archivedate=4 March 2012 }}</ref>
* 2006: Thomson Medal awarded by the [[International Mass Spectrometry Foundation]]
